🏢 MI HB 6251 — Michigan Could Slow Down New Data Centers

Michigan could require developers of large data centers to submit detailed energy and thermal management plans before construction begins. This new law would apply to data centers with a combined electrical load of 25 megawatts or more, or those expanding to meet that threshold. ...
